name: Small Brass Key
summary: The Small Brass Key is hidden in one of Bookie Herod’s ledger books at Kurzen’s Compound. It fits a strongbox in the Stockpile, where Herod keeps his valuables.

sections.title: A Key in the Ledger
sections.body: Herod’s papers point you toward the Stockpile, a cavern behind Kurzen’s Compound in Stranglethorn Vale. The Small Brass Key is tucked inside the binding of one of his ledger books. There, it may open the secure strongbox mentioned in his notes.

sections.title: Inside the Box
sections.body: The strongbox holds Herod’s more valuable coins and items. Opening it with the Small Brass Key also reveals a Muddy Note, which carries the search for the traitor onward.

faq.q: Where do I find the Small Brass Key?
faq.answer: The Small Brass Key is hidden in the binding of one of Bookie Herod’s ledger books.

faq.q: What does the Small Brass Key open?
faq.answer: The Small Brass Key opens Bookie Herod’s secure strongbox in the Stockpile at Kurzen’s Compound.
Herod keeps his more valuable coins and items in the strongbox. A Muddy Note is also found there.

faq.q: What does the Muddy Note mean?
faq.answer: The Muddy Note leads the search further toward discovering the traitor.
